note: Winter's Kiss (the dagger throw): she stands in place in every frame (x and y are 0). Frames 1-3 raise (the frost aura forms), 4-5 wind-up (the dagger is frozen), 6 throw (release), 7-9 follow-through (the dagger hits on frame 7 and flies back), 10-11 catch, 12 the idle. 10 fps makes it 1.2 s.
